```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)

```

```{r, label="import data", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# === Load Data ===
location_df <- read.csv("Results/Weather/Location_Date.csv")

```

````{r, label="clean data", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# === Standardize species names for join ===
location_df$species <- tolower(location_df$species)

# === Join datasets ===
df_merged <- location_df



# === Remove rows without coordinates ===
df_clean <- df_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lat_machine_readable), !is.na(Long_machine_readable))


```

```{r, label="load koppen raster", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# === Load Köppen Raster ===
koppen_raster <- rast("Analyses/weather_and_geography/Climate_zones_June26_2/koppen_geiger_tif/1991_2020/koppen_geiger_0p00833333.tif")  # Replace with actual path

# === Extract Climate Code ===
points_vect <- vect(df_clean, geom = c("Long_machine_readable", "Lat_machine_readable"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
koppen_values <- extract(koppen_raster, points_vect)

```

```{r, label="add koppen codes", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Add extracted codes to dataframe
df_clean$koppen_code <- koppen_values[[2]]  # second column is the value

# === Lookup table ===
koppen_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
  koppen_code = 1:30,
  koppen_label = c("Af", "Am", "Aw", "BWh", "BWk", "BSh", "BSk", "Csa", "Csb", "Csc", "Cwa", "Cwb", "Cwc",
                   "Cfa", "Cfb", "Cfc", "Dsa", "Dsb", "Dsc", "Dsd", "Dwa", "Dwb", "Dwc", "Dwd",
                   "Dfa", "Dfb", "Dfc", "Dfd", "ET", "EF"),
  climate_group = c(rep("Tropical", 3), rep("Arid", 4), rep("Temperate", 9), rep("Continental", 12), rep("Polar", 2))
)


```

```{r, label="merge koppen data", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Merge to get climate group and label
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  left_join(koppen_lookup, by = "koppen_code")

# === Save cleaned dataset with coordinates and climate ===
write.csv(df_clean, "Cleaned_Koppen_Locations.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```

```{r, label="plot koppen data", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Plot on a world map ===
world <- map_data("world")


ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "gray95", color = "gray80") +
  geom_point(data = df_clean,
             aes(x = Long_machine_readable, y = Lat_machine_readable, color = climate_group),
             size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Tropical" = "#1b9e77", "Arid" = "#d95f02", "Temperate" = "#7570b3",
    "Continental" = "#e7298a", "Polar" = "#66a61e")) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Amanita Sample Locations by Climate Group",
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", color = "Climate Group"
  )

```
